pages.label: Overview
pages.description: Digital Fly Lab: fruit fly brain simulation catalogue. What you can try online, what is real (our own test: we ran the FlyWire map and its wiring turned a simulated fly away from a looming shadow), and how to build your own.

pages.label: Projects catalogue
pages.description: Searchable catalogue of fruit fly brain simulation projects with GitHub code, online demos, licences, setup needs, update dates and evidence grades.

pages.label: DOOMFLY
pages.description: DOOMFLY, the viral fruit fly brain that plays Doom: how the MaleCNS simulation drives the game, which parts are hand-made, and why a brainless autopilot survives almost as long.

pages.label: Shiu et al. brain model
pages.description: The Shiu et al. 2024 Drosophila whole-brain model (FlyWire, Brian2): what it needs to run, tested and untested steps, 91% vs 95% explained, known issues and the projects built on it.

pages.label: DesktopFly
pages.description: DesktopFly, the desktop pet fruit fly: how its 668-neuron FlyWire circuit and MaleCNS leg circuit work, why it is grade C, what you need to build it, and a warning about fake download copies.

pages.label: flyvis (fly vision model)
pages.description: flyvis, the connectome-constrained model of fruit fly motion vision (Lappalainen et al. 2024): what it predicts, quoted numbers, licences, the 50 pretrained models and the missing shuffled-wiring control.

pages.label: Video gallery
pages.description: Fruit fly brain simulation videos in English and other languages: Doom, Minecraft, Beat Saber and Eon demos, each with its evidence grade and what the video does not show.

pages.label: Ways to try the fly
pages.description: Fly brain in a computer: online browser demos, notebooks and no-install options, and our headless-browser check of six demos: which ran, what they download and where the brain runs.

pages.label: How it works
pages.description: How a fruit fly brain simulation works: the FlyWire connectome (a map, not a brain) and other datasets compared, neuron models, NeuroMechFly (FlyGym) and flybody bodies, and who does what when a brain drives a body or turns from a looming shadow.

pages.label: Is it real?
pages.description: Is the fruit fly brain simulation real, AI, or just a map? Digital Fly Lab: fruit fly brain simulation catalogue. Our looming test (we ran the map), plain answers on AI, suffering and game use, and verdicts on viral claims with check dates.

pages.label: Does fly wiring help?
pages.description: Does real fruit fly connectome wiring help? 38 control studies compared, including our own pre-registered tests: four ways to scramble the fly brain, who does the walking in a FlyGym body, and a looming shadow that turns it. Brain vs no-brain baselines and a checklist for fair controls.

pages.label: Build your own
pages.description: Build your own fruit fly brain simulation: a tested beginner guide (re-tested 5 Oct 2026) from an empty folder to a working project, with exact commands, a shuffled-wiring control, a FlyGym walking body and a tested looming sense.

pages.label: For AI agents
pages.description: Machine-usable instructions for AI agents: stable routes, catalogue record fields, evidence grades, date meanings and the citation rule. No API.

pages.label: Research
pages.description: Index of every Digital Fly Lab research report, with method, sources and limitations.

pages.label: New and updated
pages.description: Dated changelog of new and materially updated fruit fly brain projects, grade changes and site changes.
